title: Spatial Search by Nonlinear Quantum Walk
summary: Many-body quantum systems with effective nonlinearities have been shown to speed up quantum search on the complete graph, \textit{i.e.}, the combinatorial version of Grover's algorithm, at the expense of the number of particles needed for the effective nonlinearity to hold. Physically, however, data may not be arranged in an all-to-all network, and the task of searching incomplete graphs is the spatial search problem.
